method: One entry per projectile that the form-factor screen flagged. The screen is unchanged: this register answers it, record by record. A decision of genuine means a held source states the coefficient and the shape explains the form factor. Any other decision means the value was corrected or withdrawn, so the record leaves the flag list. The verifier treats an entry as stale when its record is no longer flagged.
